segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The roaring wind faded to a peaceful, freezing hum as the peppermint balloon leveled off high above Everfrost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Below you, the village looked like a dark fairy-tale kingdom carved from ice and shadow. Snow-capped roofs and frozen canals wound through the valley under a sky dancing with emerald and violet auroras. In the distance, the Grand Clock stood like a silent mountain of brass, its pendulum still swinging in cold, ominous silence.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan was leaning his massive, ninety-pound head directly against your knee, letting out contented snorts as you vigorously scratched the sweet spot right behind his black-speckled ears. His little docked tail was buzzing back and forth so fast it was a white blur against the wicker basket.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRUNCH-MUNCH-CRUNCH.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: You are an angel,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan sighed, swallowing another turkey nubbie and leaning his heavy weight affectionately against your legs.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: A small, coat-wearing angel of savory treats and elite scratching technique. I would fly into a volcano for you. As long as the volcano was kept at a comfortable, non-scary temperature.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip leaned against the brass railing, his trench coat blowing in the wind, his fancy British accent fully restored:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Ahem. An adequate extraction, Titan. Slightly lacking in military decorum, but acceptable.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip pulled the thick, leather-bound journal of C.M. from his coat and laid it across an oak navigation chest.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Now then,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip said solemnly.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: We must decipher the Clockmaker’s notes. The clock has struck twelve. Time is running backward. We need to know how to stop the primary escapement before Christmas Day.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan leaned his massive head over the table, squinting through his flight goggles at the gold-embossed letters on the cover: C.M.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan gasped. His little docked tail froze.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Sweet mother of gravy...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan whispered, his jowls quivering.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: That’s Barnaby's master's journal.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and Pip both turn to look at him.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Who is Barnaby?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you ask.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Barnaby Grumble,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan whispered, looking nervously at the clouds as if someone might be listening.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The old master clock-smith. Centurys ago, before Everfrost was built, Barnaby was the Clockmaker's only apprentice. He helped forge the original gears.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: An apprentice?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip shouted, his tail bristling.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Where is he?! Why haven't I found him?!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Because he's in hiding!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan said.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: When the Clockmaker started going mad with jealousy, Barnaby tried to warn Santa. The Clockmaker locked Barnaby out, and now the Nutcrackers are hunting him. He's holed up in the Clockwork Scrap-Junkyard in the East Chasm. Nobody goes there. It's full of broken toys, guard traps, and... and spooky noises!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan shivered, whimpered, and leaned all of his heavy weight into your lap for comfort.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You smile, giving his big blocky head another warm scratch, and look out through the clouds at the jagged, icy peaks of the East Chasm.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Titan,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say gently.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Turn the balloon toward the East Chasm. We're going to meet Barnaby.
